topics.label: Lecture opening and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session, connects it to prior practicals, and outlines the day's learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor viruses, cellular oncogenes, and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the study of transforming tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays for cell transformation.

topics.label: Cancer mutation classifications and tumor suppressor mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the functional definitions of oncogenes and tumor suppressors and explore how specific mutations alter cellular phenotype in pathways such as Rb and p53.

topics.label: Mechanisms of sequence and chromosomal instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how failures in DNA repair, replication fidelity, and mitotic segregation drive distinct forms of genetic instability in cancer.

topics.label: Multi-step tumor progression and hereditary predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how mutations accumulate stepwise during cancer evolution and how inherited germline mutations accelerate this progression.

topics.label: Lecture closing and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session, recommends further reading, and previews the next lecture.
